response.overview: Two Feet, One Angel is a touching, lyrical fantasy piece coloured by Ramiro Puerta’s effervescent sense of humour, buoyed by exuberant choreography and topped off by Vitier’s lively soundtrack. Ramiro plays Juan, whose life is cut prematurely short. His genial soul soft-shoes through the streets, intervening on behalf of the ill-treated and dancing with the angels from his own life. He needs no halo — magnificent in a mauve three-piece suit and dancing blithely to the heavenly sounds of simple neighbourhood life, he is the very picture of grace.
response.title: Two Feet, One Angel
